applicability_conditions: Based on the Ashby–Orowan relationship; applied to precipitation strengthening in Fe–Mn–C–Al low-density steel containing Ti, V, and Nb carbide precipitates; M = 3.06 for face-centered cubic (fcc) metals.
purpose: Calculates the yield strength improvement (precipitation strengthening, Δσ_p) from the precipitation volume fraction f and precipitate size D, based on the Ashby–Orowan relationship.

symbols.meaning: yield strength improvement due to precipitation
Burgers vector (the context text states 'G and b are the shear modulus', which appears to conflate G and b; the ln(D/2b) term requires b to be a length)

unmapped: The numerical prefactors 0.847, 1.2, and √(3/(2π)) are part of the Ashby–Orowan relationship and are not individually explained in the surrounding text.
